scope: Collector overhead only; no native speed gate or guaranteed precision.

analysis.statistic: Median instrumented/original wall ratio; overall and each category.
analysis.requirement: Observed median and upper 95% bound <=1.05 for overall and every category.
analysis.resampling: Resample four complete ABBA windows, then two paired launch blocks within each selected window, categories and paired repetitions. Category-only intervals hold the category fixed.
analysis.stop_rule: Collect the entire fixed schedule unless capture/guard failure requires restoration. No early eligibility stopping or extension until passing.
analysis.missing_failed_incompatible: Retain every record; no dropping, repairing, pooling with the pilot, or eligible decision from incomplete inputs.

required_before_execution: Freeze fresh nonce/body/header ledgers and exact command/profile/runtime fingerprints.
Implement and test the expanded block-aware reviewer; the four-phase pilot comparator cannot analyze this schedule.
Verify every native input/final ID count and HTTP accounting; matching paired body/response/prompt hashes and zero reuse.
Run source/tokenizer/EOS audits before or after phases; keep stable observers throughout capture.
Refresh ownership, service, assets, jobs, resource baseline and independent deadline guard before each window.
Restore and independently verify original inference, configuration/intent/assets/sidecars after every window.
limitations: Four independent windows improve replication but do not guarantee the 5% bound can be established.
Within-window observations are clustered and are not independent launches or independent task samples.
Existing inconclusive pilot and unresolved timeout remain visible.
This clean stock-8bit audit is separate from the modified-checkpoint follow-up and earlier stock pilot; no samples are pooled.
